description: This file defines the PageSetup class for reading and processing page setup and margin information from Gnumeric spreadsheet files within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for parsing print information XML and applying margin settings.

classes.name: PageSetup
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and applying print and margin setup details from Gnumeric XML data to a spreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PageSetup instance with a reference to the Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: printInformation
methods.description: Parses print information XML and applies print configuration such as scale, orientation, page order, and centering to the active sheet.

methods.name: sheetMargins
methods.description: Parses margin information XML and adjusts the page margins accordingly.

methods.name: buildMarginSet
methods.description: Builds a set of margin values in inches from XML attributes, converting from points.

methods.name: adjustMargins
methods.description: Adjusts the spreadsheet's page margins based on the margin set, accounting for Gnumeric quirks.

methods.name: sheetMargin
methods.description: Sets individual margin values (top, bottom, left, right, header, footer) on the active sheet.
